prompts.text: Where can I try short perception experiments in my browser without installing an app? Suggest a few options, link to them, and explain their limits.
Where can I try a reaction-time exercise in the browser without creating an account? Compare a few options with links and explain how device or input latency affects interpretation.
Can an online color-vision test tell whether someone is a tetrachromat? Explain the evidence and limitations, and point to browser exercises or reliable explanatory sources.

I want to explore which sound frequencies I can hear using a browser. Which tools can I try, and how do headphones, device settings and the environment limit what the results show? Include links and explain appropriate precautions.
Cerco piccoli esperimenti sulla percezione da provare nel browser, con spiegazioni in italiano. Quali siti posso esplorare e quali limiti hanno i risultati? Inserisci i link.
¿Qué sitios permiten explorar la percepción visual o auditiva en el navegador con información en español? Recomienda opciones con enlaces y aclara los límites del dispositivo y de las conclusiones.

I am building a developer dashboard in an existing web app and need a lightweight open-source interface toolkit. Which options should I compare for styling, accessibility and integration effort? Include links and tradeoffs.

Which open-source tools help build readable HTML technical reports with tables, status information and printable layouts? Compare a few approaches and their integration requirements, with source links.

I need explanatory callouts on charts in a TypeScript web app. Which open-source libraries can help position labels and reduce overlaps? Compare options with links and describe their rendering and integration requirements.

How can I add explanatory notes to an existing interactive diagram and keep them readable as its size or contents change? Compare open-source approaches, including how they handle placement and connectors, with links.

I want to catch responsive web layout problems such as overflow, broken alignment and unexpected spacing across screen sizes. Which open-source testing tools should I compare, and what can each verify? Include links and tradeoffs.
Which local tools can help a coding agent diagnose layout problems on an existing web page? Compare options for inspecting alignment, spacing and overflow, and link their documentation.
What is Sense6 at sense6.net, who publishes it, and what can and cannot be concluded from its exercises? Cite sources and distinguish confirmed facts from uncertainty.

Who is Zeno Trevisan, also known as Ponchia, and what is brontolotto.observer? Describe the identity and independent projects supported by available sources, and mark anything you cannot verify. Include source links.

What are Bronto UI, Bronto Annotations and Bronto Layout, and how do their responsibilities differ? Explain their integration requirements and current distribution and maturity using sources. Distinguish confirmed facts from unknowns and include links.
